record_reviews.label: Breloc to Mașină
record_reviews.A1: Both words are familiar; that does not validate the pair.
record_reviews.A2: Car-key use is plausible, but this branded merchandise listing supplies no specific functional evidence.
record_reviews.A3: Vehicle function is mediated through keys; branding cannot replace the proposed predicate.
record_reviews.A7: The merchandise collection can also brand unrelated objects. No distinctive direct association established.
record_reviews.refutation: A brand logo or vehicle-themed souvenir is not evidence of a functional accessory-to-vehicle relation.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: Unearned context shortcut beyond the accepted Cheie attachment.

record_reviews.label: Breloc to ușă
record_reviews.A2: Door-key familiarity cannot make the accessory itself a door-operating tool.
record_reviews.A3: The supported operation belongs to Cheie, not Breloc.
record_reviews.A7: This collapses a mediated key relationship into a shortcut without a distinct direct function.
record_reviews.refutation: A decorative key accessory need not be attached to any door key.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: No justified benefit beyond the existing key anchor.

record_reviews.label: Breloc to Cheia de la gât
record_reviews.research_state_action: Retain held; no source hunt repeated unchanged.
record_reviews.A1: Cultural endpoint may be recognizable; original r3 recognition does not prove this relationship.
record_reviews.A3: No source establishes use of this frozen accessory in the specific practice.
record_reviews.A7: Shared key wording does not make the accessory distinctive to that cultural memory.
record_reviews.refutation: The key can be worn on a cord without a breloc.

record_reviews.label: Breloc to fluier
record_reviews.research_state_action: Preserve rejected mapping; retain the multifunction-product fact separately.
record_reviews.A1: The words are familiar, but the canonical endpoint means a referee's instrument.
record_reviews.A2: An outdoor emergency model does not establish the sport association.
record_reviews.A3: The witnessed whistle sense does not map to the frozen referee-signalling description.
record_reviews.A7: A particular multifunction accessory cannot generalize the frozen Breloc to that sport endpoint.
record_reviews.refutation: Emergency signalling and referee signalling are distinct uses.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: No honest route to the current endpoint.

record_reviews.label: Pâlnie to lichid
record_reviews.research_state_action: Retain qualified researched hypothesis; no ready/selected transition.
record_reviews.A1: Familiar tool and basic liquid concept.
record_reviews.A2: Central household transfer function is legible.
record_reviews.A3: Caption describes use for pouring liquids; it does not classify Pâlnie as a liquid.
record_reviews.A7: A characteristic funnel function, rather than arbitrary co-occurrence. The broad state-of-matter endpoint remains an abstraction and cannot gain target approval.
record_reviews.refutation: Dry-material uses exist but do not refute or expand this exact liquid caption.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: Plausible explanatory anchor or optional hop; actual ordinary usefulness NOT RUN.

record_reviews.label: Pâlnie to Ulei
record_reviews.A1: Familiar household tool and cooking ingredient.
record_reviews.A2: Transfer between household containers is a concrete understandable use.
record_reviews.A3: Retain cooking-oil and possible-transfer wording; do not include motor oil or universal bottle fit.
record_reviews.A7: A concrete functional liquid instance, stronger than a theme or brand association; it still shares the same transfer mechanism as water.
record_reviews.refutation: One product's neck limits prevent universal compatibility claims, not the qualified possible use.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: Plausible distinct ingredient anchor; measured game benefit NOT RUN.

record_reviews.label: Pâlnie to Șampon
record_reviews.research_state_action: Preserve the true narrow filling example; hold adoption and do not count it as quality-cleared connectivity.
record_reviews.A1: Words and liquid-shampoo endpoint are recognizable.
record_reviews.A2: A supplier DIY formulation/bottling tutorial does not establish an ordinary spontaneous household association.
record_reviews.A3: The optional qualified caption is source-true; manufacture, effectiveness and universal compatibility remain excluded.
record_reviews.A7: The witnessed use follows the general pourable-liquid affordance. Evidence does not yet show why this particular hygiene endpoint should receive a distinctive player association.
record_reviews.refutation: The same funnel step could fill many prepared liquid products; a single formulation tutorial cannot supply familiarity or normal-play salience.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: Insufficiently established; a forced warm-target case would not resolve the concern.

record_reviews.label: Pâlnie to Detergent
record_reviews.research_state_action: Retain qualified researched liquid-dishwashing refill hypothesis, with modest salience and no adoption.
record_reviews.A2: Ordinary funnel refill marketing for a home application is stronger support than specialized concentrate packaging or a bespoke recipe.
record_reviews.A3: Keep the liquid dishwashing subtype and optional refill wording. The canonical detergent class also includes other forms and uses.
record_reviews.A7: Concrete tool-for-refill function supports a plausible association; its broad transfer affordance does not justify arbitrary strength or warmth.
record_reviews.refutation: Powder and other detergents are outside this caption; neither unread Delphis text nor specialized Greiner packaging can enlarge support.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: Plausible refill anchor, not proved customary use or measured fun. Ordinary gameplay NOT RUN.

record_reviews.label: Pâine to Cuțit
record_reviews.research_state_action: Retain contingency idea only; no automatic substitute selection.
record_reviews.A2: Slicing bread with a suitable knife is an ordinary understandable function.
record_reviews.A3: Existential wording se poate felia cu fits the generic knife endpoint without promising every knife works equally well.
record_reviews.A7: Specific food-to-tool relation; the missing direction is verified, but existing reverse familiarity does not prove new play value.
record_reviews.refutation: Bread knives are particular tools; preserve the optional qualification.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: Plausible optional reverse hop; selection, path effects and actual player benefit NOT RUN.

record_reviews.label: Robinet to Apă
record_reviews.A2: Water-flow control is the tap's central function.
record_reviews.A3: Flow-control caption is supported. No temperature, handedness or potability promise; the gastronomic water endpoint requires the retained household-water qualification.
record_reviews.A7: Specific device function, not generic association; missing direct counterpart verified.
record_reviews.refutation: Technical or irrigation-tap material cannot prove drinking-water suitability. The IKEA domestic instruction supports only flow control here.
record_reviews.ordinary_player_benefit: Plausible optional hop; actual feedback and mining benefit NOT RUN.
